missing.title: Agent not found
missing.body: Its Machine may not have listed its Agents yet, or the Agent is gone.

name: Name

budget.label: Today's Budget
budget.footer: Every token the Provider reports counts. The day turns at 04:00 in the Machine's own time. When it runs out, the Turn going finishes as if stopped, and no new work starts until the next day or someone adds Budget (ADR 0043).

tasks.heading: Latest Tasks
tasks.footer: Only the Tasks you started are here (ADR 0060).

work.heading: How it works
work.footer: A new model takes effect from the next Task. An Approval nobody answers before it expires counts as denied (ADR 0042, 0003).

needsOnline: The Machine is offline. The Agent's settings can be changed once it is back online (ADR 0006).

character.detail: How it looks and moves in the Inbox

problem.provider: Provider {{provider}} is no longer on the Machine, so this Agent can't answer. Pick a new Provider below.
problem.model: Provider {{provider}} no longer lists model {{model}}. Pick a new model below.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The Agent stops and moves to Deleted Agents. Its Workdir and Task history stay on the Machine, and you can restore it for 30 days.

away.title: {{machine}} is offline.
away.body: {{name}} isn't working right now. Settings can change once the Machine is back. Messages to a Task can still be sent, and go out when it returns.
away.workFooter: These values live on {{machine}}, so they can change once it is back online (ADR 0006).
away.deleteFooter: Deleting needs the Machine to stop the Agent, so it can be deleted once {{machine}} is back online.

schedule.detail: Tasks the Agent starts on its own, on a clock
